```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₂} D] {G : CategoryTheory.Functor D C} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor C D} (adj : F ⊣ G) (A : adj.toMonad.Algebra) : G.IsSplitPair (F.map A.a) (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A
  constructor
  · exact (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)).comp (F.map a)
  · refine (adj.unit.app _).comp (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A))
    · exact A.A
    · exact (adj.unit_comp_map_eq_iff adj (F.obj A.A) (G.obj A.A) (F.map a) (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A))).mpr (by rw [ha])
```
